convoLines.text: "My wound needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."
Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Sam owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"I keep turning over the last thing Sam said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Wei grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Wei is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"The fire feels smaller without Sam. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
"Still on what's been happening."
"Right. Go on, then."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
«مرحباً! ما اسمك؟»
They answer at length. They nod, holding your gaze a beat longer.
They answer at length. They smile back, slower this time, like it just landed. "Food?"
They answer at length. You tap your chest, then theirs. Us. They nod, emphatic.
You listen hard, watching their mouth shape the words. Sounds, and the shape of meaning just out of reach.

Omar tilts their head. "...What?" You try again, slower, redder. A long beat. Then the smallest smile. "هذا صحيح.," they say — perfectly. "You meant." They knew all along; they just wanted to watch you work for it.
"Sure. I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Can we talk?" Wei sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Come see what I found. You won't believe it."
"I buried this before the Scattering. Seemed stupid to keep it secret." Wei digs up a wrapped bundle — food, still good. (+1727 kcal to the pantry.)
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"Good question." "Last time things were different. They always are." "Rafael owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Wei is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
"Still on what's been happening. That's still where we are."
You show them Pokeweed — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
They speak. You understand none of it.
They answer at length. They nod back, a little quicker this time.
They answer at length. A smile, tired but real. "Fuck you."
They answer at length. You press a hand to your own chest, then point at them. Together — they get it.
They spread their hands, smiling — the words are missing, but the meaning lands anyway.
"Yeah? What's up? Anyway."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"This was good." They mean it.

lines: d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Sam Martin is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d32: 🕯️ Sam Martin is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d32: What Sam kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d32: "Sam's gone." Wei looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Sam." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d32: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Aria blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d32: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.

d32: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Sam's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d32: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Sam Martin, 32 days. The mantle passes to Aria Thompson.
d32: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Aria Thompson, 23 — a musician. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Bloodhound, Scream Cheese.
d32: The village's quarrel was with Sam — and Sam is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

d32: The fire knew Aria before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
